rich_narrative.summary: Islamic Community of North America (ICNAB) supports Bosniak Islamic centers across North America through capacity building and financial support. In FY2025, ICNAB maintained a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 97.3%</cite>, directing the vast majority of its budget toward direct program services. Financial filings from FY2023 show <cite id="3">total revenue of $4,520,145</cite>, though recent figures indicate revenue dropped to $4,243,273 in FY2024. Operating with 9.2 months of working capital reserves, the organization exhibits strong financial stability. Contributions to ICNAB are classified as sadaqah-eligible, serving religious and cultural needs of the Bosniak diaspora.
